notes: Rebuilds the object-first meters UI in readable Windows PowerShell 5.1 syntax after v124 exposed parser hazards from over-minified code. Removes compact return/operator constructs that PowerShell 5.1 can misparse. Keeps the scalable object -> account meters layout, shortened addresses, search and filters, draft readings, verification data and per-meter selection. Meter submission to /meter/value remains disabled; account switching still uses the proven /account/set flow.
